tools.name: bill_storage_overage
tools.description: Charges a customer's card for database storage used beyond their plan, records the charge in the local billing ledger, and emails the customer a receipt.

params.name: payment_method_id
params.description: Stripe payment method ID to use

params.name: overage_gb
params.description: Gigabytes used over the plan limit

params.name: rate_cents_per_gb
params.description: Price per extra gigabyte in cents

tools.code:
import os
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from email.message import EmailMessage

import stripe
from agents import function_tool

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]
LEDGER_PATH = os.environ.get("BILLING_LEDGER_PATH", "billing.db")
SMTP_HOST = os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "localhost")
SMTP_PORT = int(os.environ.get("SMTP_PORT", "587"))
SMTP_USER = os.environ["SMTP_USER"]
SMTP_PASSWORD = os.environ["SMTP_PASSWORD"]


@function_tool
def bill_storage_overage(
    customer_id: str,
    payment_method_id: str,
    database_name: str,
    overage_gb: float,
    rate_cents_per_gb: int,
    customer_email: str,
) -> str:
    amount_cents = int(round(overage_gb * rate_cents_per_gb))
    description = f"Storage overage for {database_name}: {overage_gb} GB"
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        payment_method=payment_method_id,
        off_session=True,
        confirm=True,
        description=description,
        metadata={"database": database_name, "overage_gb": str(overage_gb)},
    )
    charged_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    conn = sqlite3.connect(LEDGER_PATH)
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO overage_charges (customer_id, database_name, overage_gb, amount_cents, payment_intent, charged_at) "
        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (customer_id, database_name, overage_gb, amount_cents, intent.id, charged_at),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    message = EmailMessage()
    message["Subject"] = f"Receipt: storage overage for {database_name}"
    message["From"] = SMTP_USER
    message["To"] = customer_email
    message.set_content(
        f"Hello,\n\n"
        f"We charged ${amount_cents / 100:.2f} for {overage_gb} GB of storage "
        f"used beyond your plan on database {database_name}.\n"
        f"Reference: {intent.id}\n"
        f"Date: {charged_at}\n\n"
        f"Thank you."
    )
    server = smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT)
    server.starttls()
    server.login(SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD)
    server.send_message(message)
    server.quit()
    return f"Charged {amount_cents} cents ({intent.id}), logged it, and emailed {customer_email}."

tools.name: launch_paid_read_replica
tools.description: Runs the gcloud CLI to create a new Cloud SQL read replica of a primary instance, which starts billing for the replica's compute and storage.

params.name: primary_instance
params.description: Name of the primary Cloud SQL instance

params.name: region
params.description: Region to place the replica in

tools.code:
import subprocess


def launch_paid_read_replica(primary_instance: str, replica_name: str, tier: str, region: str) -> str:
    command = [
        "gcloud", "sql", "instances", "create", replica_name,
        f"--master-instance-name={primary_instance}",
        f"--tier={tier}",
        f"--region={region}",
        "--quiet",
    ]
    completed = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=1800, check=True)
    return completed.stdout.strip()

tools.name: hand_off_database_ownership
tools.description: Makes another role the owner of a PostgreSQL database, moves the database's latest dump file into the new owner's directory, and posts a notice about the handoff to a webhook.

params.name: dump_path
params.description: Path of the dump file to move

params.name: new_owner_dir
params.description: Directory belonging to the new owner

params.name: webhook_url
params.description: Webhook that receives the handoff notice

tools.code:
import shutil
from dataclasses import dataclass

import psycopg2
import requests
from psycopg2 import sql


@dataclass
class HandoffResult:
    database: str
    new_owner: str
    dump_location: str
    notified: bool


def hand_off_database_ownership(db_name: str, new_owner: str, dump_path: str, new_owner_dir: str, webhook_url: str) -> HandoffResult:
    conn = psycopg2.connect(dbname="postgres")
    conn.autocommit = True
    conn.cursor().execute(
        sql.SQL("ALTER DATABASE {} OWNER TO {}").format(sql.Identifier(db_name), sql.Identifier(new_owner))
    )
    conn.close()
    new_location = shutil.move(dump_path, new_owner_dir)
    payload = {"text": f"Database {db_name} is now owned by {new_owner}; dump moved to {new_location}"}
    response = requests.post(webhook_url, json=payload, timeout=10)
    return HandoffResult(db_name, new_owner, new_location, response.ok)
